services.desc: Experience fishing Narragansett Bay and the beautiful waters of Rhode Island Sound for Striped Bass! Experience some of the best striped bass fishing Rhode Island has to offer aboard Coastal Current Charters. From May through October, Captain Martin targets migrating striped bass throughout Narragansett Bay, Rhode Island Sound, Newport, Block Island, and other productive local waters, adapting each trip to the latest tides, weather, bait movements, and fishing conditions. Every striped bass charter is fully customized to your goals. services.desc: Explore Bristol, Newport, Narragansett Bay & Rhode Island's beautiful coastline by private boat. Experience the beauty of Rhode Island's coastline aboard a private sightseeing cruise with Coastal Current Charters. Based in Bristol, Rhode Island, we offer customized cruises throughout Narragansett Bay and the surrounding coastal waters, with convenient pickup locations including Bristol, Newport, Jamestown, and Prudence Island.
